bio: A sea-tern chick that paddles about on a scrap of driftwood and shouts at bigger boats.
A tern that wins every race on the lake and tells everyone about its database afterwards.
A tern that carries an island on its back, with a house on top. It bought the island to have somewhere to keep the trophies.
note: Already thinks the harbour is too small.
Changes the rules of the regatta between heats.
The sixth-largest thing in the sky by net worth.
